text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thump, thump, thump, thump!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Around the fourth corner they go! Who's
going to
make their move?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: C'mon, c'mon! Go, Machan! Gooo!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: You can do it, Machan!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(It's like all their lenses are dancing.
They're fixed
on me, bathing me in their
attention.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: (Which means now's the time! I've got to leave a deeper impression! Deeper!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Yaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hehehehe...
Cheers! Applause!
Adulation!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Fantasy Stakes was spectacular.
Everyone
was so captivated by Aston
Machan, they could
barely stay in their
seats.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. That should keep me in
everyone's
memories for a little while.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Splendid. Just splendid.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A delighted Aston Machan turns to
make her exit,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She suddenly falls.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I thought something felt loose during
the race.
It was you, was it?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's looking at her feet. I follow her
line of sight
and see that one of her
cleats is broken.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
It looks like it finally wore out. Well, at
least it
didn't affect my running.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wow... I'm pretty amazing, aren't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She pulled off a performance like that
on
unstable cleats?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Machan's running was already enough to
wow the
audience. If they found out
about her broken
cleat, I can only
imagine how hyped they'd be for
her
next race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, I'm struck by a flash of
inspiration.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's current goal is to make
a name
for herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What happened today could become
the spark
that launches her popularity
into the
stratosphere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I'm still getting my thoughts
together, I
try to explain my idea to
Aston Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oooh!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
There's also the record I achieved in that

scrimmage... And the breakaway from
today...
This and that... My lovely
musings...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The more I think about it, the more
stories I have
to share. And I'm sure they
won't end here, either!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The answer is yes! Please tell every
person you
possibly can!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, I spend a long night brainstorming.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we want to reach the largest possible
audience,
we'll need a format that lets
us share a simple
message with a
relatively small number of words
and
images.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, the Aston Machan Comic Blog is born.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for doing this for me! Am I
allowed to
pitch ideas for the comics?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yay. In that case, here's how I think the
first one
should go.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The first panel would be Machan tearing
up the
track at the Fantasy Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Then, the second panel shows the
stands, where
everyone is on their feet
cheering. "Bravo,
Machan!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next comes the big reveal! "She did it all
on a
broken cleat?! We could be dealing
with a
prodigy here!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Finally, we finish with a promise for the
future.
"Fly onward, Machan! The
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies
awaits!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but notice she just picked
her next
race without consulting me, but
it's not a bad
choice at all. It would be
perfect as a prelim for
the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So there we have it—our next race is the
Hanshin
Juvenile Fillies. With the new
blog off the ground,
it's time to kick
training into high gear!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wheeze, huff, puff! Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Machan's ownin' everyone, and
Scarlet's upped
her game too.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: But that doesn't mean jack!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
'Cause victory's gonna be all mine, baby!
Look
out for Vodka!
RAAAHHH!
